name: Search Intent and Semantic Volume Reconnaissance
phase: Customer Discovery and Problem Validation Tactics
hypothesis: We believe that consumers are actively searching for ways to solve [problem X]. We will verify this by analyzing search engine queries across targeted keyword groups, and consider it validated if high-intent terms show ≥ 2,500 monthly organic queries with a year-over-year growth rate of ≥ 20%.

plan.label: Preparation
plan.text: Compile seed variants of high-intent syntax: how to automate X, X alternative, X compliance template.

plan.label: Execution
plan.text: Query volume databases for regional density, historical trend, cost per click and competitor saturation.

plan.label: Data collection
plan.text: Split queries into informational, navigational, commercial and transactional, then total commercial volume.

planFull.label: Preparation
planFull.text: Compile a seed dictionary of high-intent search syntax variants (e.g., "how to automate X", "X alternative", "X compliance template").

planFull.label: Execution
planFull.text: Query search volume databases to extract regional search density, historical trajectory, cost-per-click bids, and competitor domain saturation.

planFull.label: Data collection
planFull.text: Segment search queries into Informational, Navigational, Commercial, and Transactional categories. Calculate the total addressable commercial search volume.

warning.label: Informational Intent Conflation
warning.text: High informational volume can mean curiosity or free-guide seekers, not buyers with commercial intent.

warningFull: High search volumes for informational queries often signify academic curiosity or individuals looking for free guides, rather than buyers demonstrating commercial intent.
